name: City Council Meeting - Special
agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to take
place at City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA at 9:30 a.m. on
Saturday, June 18, 2011 for the purpose of conducting a closed session regarding personnel matters.
The agenda for the special meeting with the precise items of business to be transacted or discussed
is set forth below.

Posted by City Clerk on June 17, 2011  June 18, 2011
  9:30 A.M.
  City Hall, Council Chambers
  340 Palos Verdes Drive West,
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry
concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made
available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, prior to the
meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council shall
fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits
the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific
agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES

  June 18, 2011

A special meeting of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates was called
to order this day at 9:30 a.m. in the City Council Chamber by Mayor John Rea.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Goodhart , Perkins, Humphrey,
  Mayor Pro Tem Bird, Mayor Rea

ABSENT:  None

ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Hoefgen, City Attorney Hogin

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC – No one came forward to speak.

RECESS ANNOUNCEMENT OF ITEMS TO BE DISCUSSED IN CLOSED
SESSION

City Attorney Hogin announced recess to Closed Session at 9:32 a.m. to discuss items on
the posted agenda pursuant to Government Code section 54957.

CLOSED SESSION AGENDA

1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Government Code § 54957
  Title: City Manager

2.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE/DISMISSAL/RELEASE

3.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Government Code § 54957
  Title: City Manager

RECONVENE INTO OPEN SESSION

At 10:38 a.m., Council reconvened in open session.

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING  1
JUNE 18, 2011
 City Attorney Hogin announced that the Council had met in closed session, discussed the
items listed on the posted agenda and took one reportable action. She announced that the
City Council had voted unanimously to terminate the employment contract with Joe
Hoefgen as City Manager and the license agreement between him and the City by which
he occupies the house owned by the City. She stated that the termination was without
cause.

Mayor Rea thanked Mr. Hoefgen for his service to the City.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, Mayor Rea adjourned the meeting at 10:39 a.m. to
Tuesday, June 28, 2011 in Council Chambers of City Hall.

  RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  VICKIE KRONEBERGER,
  EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT/DEPUTY CITY CLERK

ATTEST:

CHRISTI HOGIN, CITY ATTORNEY

APPROVED:

WILLIAM JOHN REA, MAYOR

SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING  2
JUNE 18, 2011
